name: inji-interop-playground
description: A unified sandbox for testing Verifiable Credential interoperability across the Inji stack and external OpenID4VCI/OpenID4VP implementations.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n bff,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @interop/bff" "npm run dev -w @interop/web"
scripts.dev:bff: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @interop/bff
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @interop/bff && npm run build -w @interop/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && node --import tsx --test apps/bff/test/*.test.ts
